title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E23 — The Kid
Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E24 — Rated X
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E1 — Crossed Swords
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal of money and decides auctioning off the piece will bring the best price. Fred's actions as a shill backfire, shattering Lamont's chance for freedom...and the statue.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E20 — George And Jimmy
When George calls President Carter as a publicity stunt, he gets more publicity than he expected and the Jeffersons get a night they'll never forget.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E21 — Thomas H. Willis & Co
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E14 — Slappy White, Tim Conway
Slappy does stand-up; sketches include Pink Pirate (Conway) w/castaways (Flip & Slappy) and a convoluted con game.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E15 — James Coco, Barbara McNair, Jim Nabors
Coco, Nabors & Flip do theater parody; Freddie Johnson shops for a card and Geraldine battles McNair to be queen of a parade.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E17 — Marty Feldman, Howard Cosell, Sandy Duncan
Marty Feldman battles the Beast In The Basket and Howard Cosell judges Sandy & Flip's cakes in the county fair bake-off.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E19 — Phyllis Diller, The Committee
Flip seeks a loan; Phyllis does her classic stand-up and comedy troupe The Committee do hilarious sketches.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E21 — In A New Way
Entertainment is provided by The Spinners and the Jimmy Castor Bunch.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E22 — Wherever We May Be
Stokely Carmichael, the revolutionary leader who created and promulgated the now historic cry of "Black Power.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E8 — Secrets
The son of George's boss bullies Webster into doing his schoolwork, or else the kid will tell his dad to fire George.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E9 — A Test of Characters
Webster's crafts instructor takes credit for Web's winning picture in a photo contest.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E10 — Freedom of the Press
Webster's article in the school paper exposes the personal problems of a teacher Katherine is counseling.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E11 — Seeing It Through
Webster feels guilty that his success as a dog-walker comes at the expense of his predecessor; and the expense of home repairs spurs Katherine to try to fix things herself.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E12 — Katherine the Brave
Katherine takes over the role of scout leader for Webster's scout troop. Another male leader doesn't like the idea of a woman scout leader. When an injury calls for quick thinking, Katherine comes to the rescue.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E2 — The Break-Up
Lisa decides it's time to "dump" Terrence and forbids Ray from hanging out with him, while Roger tries to pick which twin to "woo.".

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E3 — The Tutor
When a high school football star needs a tutor, Tamera pretends to be Tia so she can teach him a special lesson in "chemistry"!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E4 — History A La Cart
An embarrassing arrest from his college days comes back to haunt Ray, and Lisa turns an inheritance into a shopping spree.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E5 — Grandpa Campbell
When Ray's ne'er-do-well father comes for a visit, he turns the household upside-down -- and turns Tamera into a ruthless businesswoman!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E6 — Twins Get Fired
When Tia becomes Tamera's new boss at Rocket Burger, they both learn a lesson in responsibility.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E20 — The Prom
Moesha’s date for the proms cancels at the last minute.  She goes unescorted and meets a handsome mysterious boy who disappears at midnight.  She tries to find him, but to no avail.
